arguments.prompt: Create one isolated Cartoon water effect for SPLASH.BMP frame002. First input is the exact original sprite: preserve its particular silhouette, proportions, relative positioning of parts, open transparent areas and number of significant tongues/drops. White source shapes are actual foam; black background is transparent and any dark diagnostic contour must not become dark water. Required form: An asymmetric collapsing splash crown, much lower than000: the main bowl along lower-left/middle, one narrow tall central tongue, several shorter left tips and a sweeping rightward edge, plus a few separate droplets high above/right. Preserve all open transparent gaps within/between the thin splash sheets. Sparse shape, no broad solid puddle. Second input is a shared water materials/style key ONLY, not pose or amount of water. Use clean luminous white foam, pale cyan/light-blue restrained cel shading and thin medium-blue contour accents. NO heavy black outline, navy shadow, dark cast shadow, dark puddle, gray haze or glow. No animals, ground, scenery, ocean horizon or text. Do not turn thin open source forms into a generic solid mound. Real alpha transparency in all background and holes. Complete shape and every droplet fully inside a comfortably padded canvas. Crisp smooth Cartoon artwork, not literal pixel art.
